children: Bitcoin News said on X that Coldcard is replenishing dealer inventory in batches as it produces new devices. According to Odaily, the company said several dealers have requested additional stock, and the devices continue to sell after an entropy vulnerability led to more than $100 million in Bitcoin being stolen about a month ago.

title: Coldcard Restocks Dealer Inventory After Entropy Vulnerability Led to Bitcoin Theft
